question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word from the passage.**

**Hostile**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Warlike**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"hostile"** means unfriendly; antagonistic. It can describe a person or a situation that is opposed to or against someone or something. (शत्रुतापूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example: **The negotiations between the two companies became hostile when neither side would compromise.
 
 
 
• **"Warlike"** refers to being eager for or inclined towards conflict or war; aggressive. (युद्धप्रिय)
 
 
• **Example: **The warlike stance of the country led to increased tensions in the region.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that a synonym of **'hostile'** is **'warlike'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Warlike**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ancient** (प्राचीन): Belonging to the very distant past and no longer in existence.

 
 
• **Example:** The ancient ruins of the city attract many tourists.
 
 
 
• **Magnificent** (शानदार): Extremely beautiful, elaborate, or impressive.
 
 
• **Example: **The palace was magnificent with its grand architecture and stunning gardens.
 
 
 
• **Permanent** (स्थायी): Lasting or intended to last or remain unchanged indefinitely.
 
 
• **Example:** They are looking for a permanent solution to the problem.
